verdict.rationale: treg documents 159 operations, publishes a live OpenAPI spec (probe confirms openapi.json), and says every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response, with curl-style request examples in the docs. None of this shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples; the reference appears to be static docs plus a machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer UI, runnable/try-it examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
